title: ZE17 01 — miasto wiadukt
description: Fragment 1/18 jednego ciągłego ujęcia. First f0001 → Last f0049. 3 s, 24 fps, normalne tempo 1×; bez przyspieszania. Pozycja w sekwencji: 0–3 s. Last jest identyczny plikowo z First następnego shota. Tło bez pióra; pióro będzie warstwą z Blendera. Wybrane obrazy zachowują różnice odnotowane w _system/clean-plates-v001/pair-audit-v003.json; przygotowanie shota nie oznacza zatwierdzenia wszystkich detali.

chronology.stateRule: This shot is canonical evidence of world state at this exact story moment. Later timeline clips in this project and later projects override it when determining current canon.

referenceUsage.provenanceRule: activeFrames contains the exact references recorded for the active image revision; revisions preserves the complete visual provenance history. declared contains the wider shot context.

prompts.image: Generate a NEW photorealistic BACKGROUND PLATE, not an edit. There is NO FEATHER, no bird, no floating foreground object anywhere. Image1 is the feather-free Blender spatial blueprint: retain its camera projection, crop, object placement and sizes exactly. Supporting reference images supply only specified identities/designs/materials. Keep framing even if it seems empty; foreground subject will be composited later. Do not fill the empty foreground or recompose. Use case: sketch-to-render. Generate a NEW single photorealistic live-action movie frame from the ORIGINAL references, never an edit of an earlier generated frame. 16:9 landscape, target1920x1080. The FIRST image is the authoritative Blender spatial blueprint. Its camera extrinsics, projection, crop, perspective, silhouettes, object positions and relative scales are LOCKED. Build realistic surfaces and shapes INSIDE those projected envelopes. Reference photos supply ONLY identity, clothing, vehicle design and real Poznań materials as specified below. Consistent early evening blue dusk, restrained warm lamps and lit windows, believable natural photographic detail. No plastic CGI, no fantasy architecture, no watermark, no captions, no invented prominent people. Primitives are spatial proxies, NOT literal cubic buildings/people/vehicles. Anatomically correct humans and mechanically plausible objects. OUTPUT ONLY ONE IMAGE. Spatial fidelity takes priority over beauty. Image2 real aerial Poznań photo is for railway and bridge detailing only. Image3 is same station architecture only. Blueprint camera looks almost vertically down, NO horizon. Grey parallel strips are steel railway tracks with concrete sleepers and gravel; wide pale strips are concrete platforms, preserve projected diagonals. Bridge parapet upper edge intersects left edge y57%, slopes down-right, exits BELOW lower right; do not move it up. Road asphalt occupies lower-left, tiny mixer corner cropped bottom-left. Foreground lamp has head at x42%,y80%. Thin details such as catenary permitted, don't alter track locations or add tracks to fill every empty area. No snow. Entire output contains no feather or white floating speck. Realistic anatomy and mechanically rigid vehicles, dry charcoal coat for the man, consistent blue dusk and warm station lights. Landscape16:9. Image4 is the canonical burgundy-gold mixer truck, only its tiny roof corner is clipped by bottom-left of image1. It is NOT a green bus or tram. Match that crop, no full truck. Bridge upper concrete edge must meet LEFT at57%height, not50%. Keep concrete parapet without added metal railing.
prompts.endFrameDescription: Wspólna klatka graniczna f0049; dokładne zakończenie segmentu i początek następnego.
prompts.animation: 0-3s: Descend in one aerial arc, turning the view clockwise from the railway overview toward the roadway. The approaching mixer grows from the lower-left edge to the upper-right part of the composition as the camera travels past it. Traffic moves continuously nose-first along the lanes relative to the fixed road; visible wheels roll, lane spacing stays constant. No vehicle stops for the camera. Preserve truck fittings, lettering, lights and vehicle proportions. Camera motion continues through both boundaries, reaching the supplied End Frame at 3s. Keep architecture rigid and dusk exposure stable. No feather, cuts, dissolves, morphs or new people. @Image1: the same mixer design only; retain the Start/End crop and visible fittings. @Image2: railway materials only, not daylight or camera layout.
